# Version Scale

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:VersionScale`](gmeow-VersionScale.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/VersionScale>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/versions`](../../slices/versions.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The magnitude scale of a version change — a VALUE, never an [`Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) subclass. Used for SemVer-style classification and analogous schemes in non-software domains.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:VersionScale`](gmeow-VersionScale.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for change magnitude — the named scales (trivial, minor, major) referenced by [`gmeow:versionScale`](../properties/gmeow-versionScale.md) for SemVer-style and analogous schemes.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-scale [`Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) subclasses and avoid using it as the role of a version (that is [`gmeow:VersionRole`](gmeow-VersionRole.md)); scales are individual values, not essential types.

### How to use

- Reference the seeded individuals from [`gmeow:versionScale`](../properties/gmeow-versionScale.md), and add new [`gmeow:VersionScale`](gmeow-VersionScale.md) individuals (label only) when a non-software scheme needs a magnitude the seeds omit.

### Examples

- ex:scaleBreaking a [`gmeow:VersionScale`](gmeow-VersionScale.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "breaking"@en.
